pairs: Raia vero filius Sobal genuit Jahath,
Truly, Reaiah, the son of Shobal,
de quo nati sunt Ahumai, et Laad:
conceived Jahath; from him were born Ahumai and Lahad.
These are the kindred of the Zorathites.
And this is the stock of Etam:
And the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
Now Penuel was the father of Gedor,
and Ezer was the father of Hushah.
isti sunt filii Hur primogeniti Ephratha patris Bethlehem.
These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratha, the father of Bethlehem.
Assur vero patri Thecuæ erant duæ uxores, Halaa et Naara.
Truly, for Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, there were two wives: Helah and Naarah.
These are the sons of Naarah.
And the sons of Helah were Zereth,
and the kindred of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
Fuit autem Jabes inclytus præ fratribus suis,
But Jabez was renowned, more so than his brothers,
et mater ejus vocavit nomen illius Jabes,
and his mother called his name Jabez,
Truly, Jabez called upon the God of Israel,
“If only, when blessing, you will bless me,
and your hand will be with me,
et feceris me a malitia non opprimi.
and you will cause me not to be oppressed by evil.”
Et præstitit Deus quæ precatus est.
And God granted to him the things for which he prayed.
Caleb autem frater Sua genuit Mahir,
Now Chelub, the brother of Shuhah, conceived Mehir,
who was the father of Eshton.
Then Eshton conceived Bethrapha, and Paseah,
the father of the city of Nahash.
These are the men of Recah.
Filii autem Cenez, Othoniel, et Saraia.
Now the sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah.
Porro filii Othoniel, Hathath, et Maonathi.
And the sons of Othniel were Hathath and Meonothai.
Saraia autem genuit Joab patrem Vallis artificum:
but Seraiah conceived Joab, the father of the Valley of Artisans.
For indeed, there were artisans there.
Truly, the sons of Chelub, the son of Jephunneh,
And the sons of Ezrah: Jether,
and Ishbah, the father of Eshtemoa.
bore Jered, the father of Gedor,
and Heber, the father of Soco,
and Jekuthiel, the father of Zanoah.
hi autem filii Bethiæ filiæ Pharaonis,
Now there were sons of Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh,
Et filii uxoris Odaiæ sororis Naham patris Ceila,
and sons of his wife Hodiah, the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite,
and Laadah, the father of Mareshah,
et cognationes domus operantium byssum in domo juramenti.
and the kindred of the house of the workers of fine linen in the house of the oath,
and he who caused the sun to stand still,
et qui reversi sunt in Lahem:
Hi sunt figuli habitantes in plantationibus et in sepibus,
These are the potters living in the Plantations and in the Hedges,
with a king in his works,
The sons of Shimei were sixteen,
fratres autem ejus non habuerunt filios multos,
But his brothers did not have many sons,
et universa cognatio non potuit adæquare summam filiorum Juda.
and the entire kindred was not equal to the sum of the sons of Judah.
hæ civitates eorum usque ad regem David.
These were their cities until king David.
Et universi viculi eorum per circuitum civitatum istarum usque ad Baal:
with all their villages, on every side of these cities, as far as Baal.
hæc est habitatio eorum, et sedium distributio.
This is their habitation and the distribution of the settlements.
And there were Meshobab and Jamlech,
et Joël, et Jehu filius Josabiæ filii Saraiæ filii Asiel,
and Joel, and Jehu, the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
Ziza quoque filius Sephei filii Allon filii Idaia filii Semri filii Samaia.
as well as Ziza, the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.
Isti sunt nominati principes in cognationibus suis,
These were the names of the leaders in their kindred.
et in domo affinitatum suarum multiplicati sunt vehementer.
And they were multiplied greatly within the houses of their marriages.
Et profecti sunt ut ingrederentur in Gador usque ad orientem vallis,
And they set out, so that they might enter into Gedor, as far as the eastern valley,
et ut quærerent pascua gregibus suis.
and so that they might seek pastures for their flocks.
Inveneruntque pascuas uberes, et valde bonas,
And they found fat and very good pastures,
et terram latissimam et quietam et fertilem,
and a very wide and quiet and fruitful land,
in qua ante habitaverant de stirpe Cham.
in which some from the stock of Ham had lived before.
Hi ergo venerunt, quos supra descripsimus nominatim,
So then, those whose names have been written above,
went forth in the days of Hezekiah,
et percusserunt tabernacula eorum, et habitatores qui inventi fuerant ibi,
the king of Judah. And they struck down the inhabitants who had been found there with their dwellings.
et deleverunt eos usque in præsentem diem:
And they wiped them out, even to the present day.
And they lived in place of them,
because they found very fat pastures there.
De filiis quoque Simeon abierunt in montem Seir viri quingenti, habentes principes Phalthiam et Naariam et Raphaiam et Oziel filios Jesi:
Also, some of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went away to mount Seir, having as leaders Pelatiah and Neariah and Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
And they struck down the remnant of the Amalekites,
those who had been able to escape,
and they lived there in place of them,
et habitaverunt ibi pro eis usque ad diem hanc.
